advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Narrow the full-prose-sentence assertions in test_agent_skill_ticket_workflow_guidance.py to the canonical tokens (flags/config keys/verdict names) they intend to guard, so behavior-preserving rewording of the skill does not break the test.
evidence: tests/unit/test_agent_skill_ticket_workflow_guidance.py:43: assert "An empty setting leaves the ticket unassigned" in text
tests/unit/test_agent_skill_ticket_workflow_guidance.py:57: assert "current-cycle agent action is complete" in text
tests/unit/test_agent_skill_ticket_workflow_guidance.py:67: assert "not a PASS" in text; :68 "passing attestation"; :69 "successful review verdict"

Rule-4 litmus: rewording these sentences while preserving the semantics of the guidance (e.g. 'Omit --assignee to use the configured default') breaks the assertions with no observable-behavior change — refactoring-violation criterion (a).
advisory.finding: Several positive assertions pin full author-prose sentences rather than canonical/machine-meaningful tokens, making them change-detectors: a behavior-preserving reword of the skill guidance (same semantics) breaks the test without any observable-behavior change. Affected: `Run claim without \`--assignee\``, `An empty setting leaves the ticket unassigned`, `Pass \`--assignee\` only for an explicit override`, `current-cycle agent action is complete`, `wait until the ticket becomes claimable`, `not a PASS`, `passing attestation`, `successful review verdict`. Unlike the tokenized asserts (`--assignee`, `ticket.default_assignee`, `coverage.llm_ran`, `INDETERMINATE`, `exit status is 2`), these fragments are consumed by an LLM, not a non-human parser, so they guard the author's phrasing rather than a contract identifier.
advisory.suggested_fix: Replace prose-sentence asserts with the minimal canonical token they protect — e.g. assert on `--assignee` / `ticket.default_assignee` / `unassigned` and on the already-present negative `"--assignee <you>" not in text`, rather than the exact sentence 'An empty setting leaves the ticket unassigned'.
